title: Remediating OOMKilled Service Pods
procedure: 1. Inspect heap usage and recent crash metrics. 2. Temporarily patch container memory resource limits from 512MiB to 1024MiB to stabilize service. 3. Trigger rolling restart of deployment to release stuck heap buffers. 4. Verify pod memory remains below 70% threshold.
command_snippet:
kubectl set resources deployment auth-service --limits=memory=1024Mi --requests=memory=512Mi
kubectl rollout restart deployment auth-service
kubectl rollout status deployment auth-service

title: Resolving PostgreSQL Connection Pool Exhaustion
procedure: 1. Identify idle-in-transaction connections in Postgres. 2. Terminate hung backend PIDs holding locks for greater than 60 seconds. 3. Increase max pool size in service environment variables or restart connection pooler (PgBouncer).
command_snippet:
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'idle in transaction' AND state_change < now() - interval '60 seconds';
kubectl scale deployment payment-api --replicas=4

title: Mitigating Upstream 504 Gateway Timeouts
procedure: 1. Check upstream inventory service health and response latency. 2. Enable circuit breaker to bypass slow dependency. 3. Scale checkout service replica count by 2x to drain incoming connection backlog.
command_snippet:
kubectl scale deployment checkout-api --replicas=6
kubectl logs -l app=checkout-api --tail=100 | grep -E '504|timeout'

title: Fixing Redis Out of Memory (OOM) Errors
procedure: 1. Connect to Redis instance via redis-cli. 2. Update memory eviction policy dynamically to allkeys-lru. 3. Trigger manual memory purge of expired keys.
command_snippet:
redis-cli CONFIG SET maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru
redis-cli MEMORY PURGE
redis-cli INFO memory

title: Recovering Pods in CrashLoopBackOff Due to Missing Environment Variables
procedure: 1. View pod termination reason and logs. 2. Validate ConfigMap and Secret bindings in deployment spec. 3. Re-apply missing environment configuration and verify pod enters Running state.
command_snippet:
kubectl describe pod -l app=order-worker
kubectl set env deployment/order-worker KAFKA_BROKER_URL=kafka-cluster.internal:9092
kubectl rollout status deployment/order-worker
